mission.headline: Opportunity should never be limited by background, income, or geography.
mission.body1: The Esposito–Dossantos Foundation empowers individuals and communities through education, music, technology, and opportunity. We remove barriers to success by providing scholarships, mentorship, cultural programs, and innovative initiatives.
mission.body2: We believe talent exists everywhere — but opportunity does not. Our work is to close that gap and inspire lifelong learning, creativity, leadership, and positive social impact around the world.

statement.mission: The Esposito–Dossantos Foundation empowers individuals and communities through education, music, technology, and opportunity. We remove barriers to success by providing scholarships, mentorship, cultural programs, and innovative initiatives that inspire lifelong learning, creativity, leadership, and positive social impact around the world.
statement.vision: To become one of the world’s leading nonprofit foundations dedicated to empowering communities through education, music, technology, and cultural enrichment — creating opportunities that inspire generations to learn, lead, and serve.

mission.belief: Built from a belief that talent exists everywhere, but opportunity does not.
mission.purpose: We exist to empower individuals of every age and background by expanding access to education, music, technology, mentorship, and life-changing opportunities — helping communities thrive while fostering the next generation of leaders, innovators, artists, and changemakers.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.body: The Esposito–Dossantos Foundation ("we", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information in line with the GDPR and applicable data-protection laws.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, email, country, and message — when you donate, subscribe, volunteer, or contact us. We also collect limited technical data, such as device and usage information, to improve our website.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use your information to process donations, respond to inquiries, send updates you have requested, and improve our programs and services. We never sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Legal Basis
sections.body: We process personal data on the basis of your consent, our legitimate interests in operating the foundation, and where necessary to comply with legal obligations.

sections.heading: Data Sharing
sections.body: We share data only with trusted service providers (such as payment and email providers) who process it on our behalf under strict confidentiality, and where required by law.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures, including encryption and access controls, to protect your information.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data, and to withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact privacy@esposito-dossantos.org.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any questions about this policy, contact us at privacy@esposito-dossantos.org.

sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms
sections.body: By accessing this website, you agree to these Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: Use of the Website
sections.body: You agree to use this website lawfully and not to misuse, disrupt, or attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of it.

sections.heading: Donations
sections.body: Donations are voluntary and processed securely through third-party providers. Tax-deductibility depends on your country of residence.

sections.heading: Intellectual Property
sections.body: All content on this website, including text, graphics, and logos, is the property of the Esposito–Dossantos Foundation or its licensors and is protected by law.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.body: The website is provided "as is". We make no warranties and are not liable for any damages arising from its use to the maximum extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Changes to These Terms
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the website constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms can be sent to info@esposito-dossantos.org.

sections.heading: What Are Cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and provide insight into how they are used.

sections.heading: How We Use Cookies
sections.body: We use essential cookies to make the site work, and, with your consent, analytics cookies to understand and improve how visitors use our site.

sections.heading: Managing Cookies
sections.body: You can accept or reject non-essential cookies via our consent banner, and manage cookies through your browser settings at any time.

sections.heading: Third-Party Cookies
sections.body: Some cookies may be set by trusted third-party services, such as analytics or payment providers, subject to their own privacy policies.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about our use of cookies, contact privacy@esposito-dossantos.org.
